source: Census 2011 DC2101EW + Census 2021 RM032/TS021 (NOMIS) + ONS SNPP Z1
methodology: 3-model ensemble: (1) Hamilton-Perry CCR from Census 2011→2021, (2) Cohort-component with ethnic TFR/mortality/migration, (3) Linear extrapolation. Simple average following Wilson et al. (2022). SNPP 2022-based envelope constraint. Model spread provides empirical uncertainty.
